title: TNCraft
description: A mod that adds new TN stuff, like armor, tools, weapons and more.
body:
# TNCraft

This mod adds new blocks, items, armor, and more, all about TN.

This mod adds:

TN Ore
TN Nugget
TN Ingot
TN Armor
TN Tools (Pickaxe, Sword, Axe, Hoe, Shovel)
TN Armor
TN Guy (Villager Profession)
TN World (Dimension)
